remarks: Experience the pinnacle of sophisticated living in this extraordinary estate by renowned builder Kaali-Nagy, perfectly situated within walking distance to the village, train, and nature center. The residence showcases impeccable craftsmanship throughout, defined by extensive custom moldings, intricate wainscoting, and an effortless flow designed for both grand entertaining and intimate daily life. At the heart of the home, a gourmet chef's kitchen features a sun-drenched breakfast room and a butler's pantry, with French doors opening to one of three private terraces for seamless indoor-outdoor transitions. Designed to elevate everyday living, the home also boasts a fully equipped private home gym, an inviting billiards room and media area, perfect for relaxed gatherings.The private property is equally impressive, boasting a spectacular 20 x 40 heated gunite pool surrounded by professionally designed, mature landscaping that creates a serene and secluded outdoor retreat-ideal for summer entertaining or peaceful relaxation. This thoughtfully designed floor plan includes five spacious ensuite bedrooms, each boasting its own walk-in closet, ensuring unparalleled comfort for family and guests alike. Complete with the modern convenience of a private elevator serving the home's multiple levels, this property offers a rare blend of timeless architectural detail, exceptional amenities, and a premier "walk-to-everything" location.
